summary: chore(shared): remove dead fxa-shared experiments module
description:
Because:
- The fxa-shared experiments module has no importer in the FxA repo.
- Its only dependency, js-md5, has no other user in fxa-shared.

This commit:
- Deletes experiments/base.ts and its mocha spec.
- Removes the experiments key from index.ts and the exports entry from package.json.
- Removes js-md5 and @types/js-md5 from fxa-shared.
- Updates yarn.lock.

Closes FXA-10657
